lead_fa: بازی Demonology Warlock فرمانروایی اهریمنان است: مدام [[Call Dreadstalkers]] و [[Wild Imp]]ها را احضار می‌کنی و [[Felguard]] را فرمان می‌دهی؛ همه‌چیز با [[Soul Shards]] تأمین می‌شود و برست تو [[Summon Demonic Tyrant]] است که به‌ازای هر شیطانِ احضارشده قوی‌تر می‌شود. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Diabolist]] که برچسب Best منبع را در هر چهار مد دارد و [[Soul Harvester]] که هم‌پایه است.

strengths: Durable spec with a large degree of survivability
High variety of talent options that can suit different group compositions
Strong solo ability thanks to pet tanking and overall self-healing
Provides instance skips with Demonic Gateway and Soulstone
weaknesses: Ramp time for DPS can be considered higher than other specs
Low burst DPS in most situations outside of cooldowns

changes_12_1.note: While there were a number of numerical changes, the playstyle of Demonology remains the same in Midnight 12.1.

hero.recommendation: Both Diabolist and Soul Harvester are on similar footing and both provide good throughput for single and multi-target damage; you often choose based on required defensive or utility value. Diabolist carries the Best tags for Raid, Raid Cleave, Mythic+ and Delves and is the more optimal choice under extreme circumstances (0.1% play); playing Soul Harvester will not be game-breaking. If you need more overall movement and increased defensives, go Diabolist for Soul-Etched Circles and Infernal Vitality; its AoE is also more passive and less reliant on Demonic Core procs than Soul Harvester.
hero.diabolist: Provides Soul-Etched Circles and Infernal Vitality for movement and defensives; its AoE is more passive and less reliant on Demonic Core procs.
hero.soul_harvester: A close alternative with its own throughput; viable everywhere without being game-breaking.

builds.notes: Diabolist carries the Best tags on all four modes and is the optimal choice under extreme circumstances; Soul Harvester is on similar footing and viable everywhere.

concepts: Do not overcap Soul Shards: never sit at the cap of 5 unspent, and do not overcap by using a Soul Shard generator at 4 Demonbolt or 5 Shadow Bolt; spender priority is Call Dreadstalkers then Hand of Gul'dan

Demon stacking: Summon Demonic Tyrant is the main demon buffing ability; always set up the maximum number of Wild Imps, your Vilefiend and Dreadstalkers when possible to maximize cooldown damage and buff uptime
A fairly simple generator-to-spender rotation with a small handful of rules; optimize damage during cooldown windows

Demonic Tyrant cycle: since the Tyrant buff is dynamically updated per demon summoned and only extends Call Dreadstalkers (with Reign of Tyranny), have Call Dreadstalkers out and on cooldown before entering the cooldown cycle
st_priority: Cast Grimoire: Imp Lord / Grimoire: Fel Ravager
aoe_priority: Cast Grimoire: Imp Lord / Grimoire: Fel Ravager
rotation.aoe_note: Generally you press all the same buttons plus Implosion and Summon Doomguard; advanced players also weave Demonbolt onto additional targets to spread Doom, since each application of Doom is its own damage source.

cooldowns.Summon Demonic Tyrant: A staple cooldown that drives a lot of the damage sequences; it extends the time of just your Call Dreadstalkers with Reign of Tyranny and gains an additional damage modifier for each demon summoned, so maximize the demons out when you cast it
cooldowns.Implosion: AoE spender that consumes your Wild Imps; the tier set 4pc gives a chance for free higher-damage Implosions
cooldowns.Summon Doomguard: Big single-target demon summon pressed in the priority and in AoE
cooldowns.Grimoire: Imp Lord / Grimoire: Fel Ravag: Grimoire demons pressed ahead of the Tyrant window

rotation.hero_notes: Demonic Core is your most common proc and an efficient way of building Soul Shards; it stacks to a maximum of 4. Bank at least 2 charges before each Summon Demonic Tyrant cooldown to quickly generate additional Soul Shards for more Wild Imps while the Tyrant is active, and ideally hold 2 charges as often as possible to avoid wasting procs.
opener: Pre-cast Demonbolt at least 4s before the pull timer ends
With Demonic Core cast Demonbolt, otherwise cast Shadow Bolt
pre_combat: Get your food buff and oil applied
Cast Create Soulwell so every party or raid member can grab a Healthstone
Place your portals as needed: personal Demonic Circle and group Demonic Gateway
Double check your talents for the boss ahead

gear.gearing_rules: General guideline: Haste = Critical Strike > Mastery > Versatility. Do not neglect Intellect: a substantial item level increase is typically worth it compared to optimized stats. Demonology likes all stats fairly equally with some preference towards Haste and Critical Strike; stats are close enough that item level is effectively your best stat. Sim with Raidbots.

tier_set.name: Damned Necrolyte's Shattered Restraints
tier_set.note: 2pc: Wild Imp damage increased by 10% and Implosion damage increased by 20%. 4pc: when their energy depletes, Wild Imps have a 20% chance to fling themselves at their target and Implode at 250% effectiveness to the main target and 225% to other targets; most of the set's power sits behind the 4-piece with its free higher-damage Implosions while the 2-piece is also very strong given how much damage Wild Imps make up.

stats.cheatsheet: Intellect > Haste = Critical Strike > Mastery > Versatility; identical for Diabolist and Soul Harvester; stats are close enough that item level is effectively your best stat.
notes: Intellect is your primary stat on cloth gear and increases spell power.
Demonology likes all stats fairly equally with some preference towards Haste and Critical Strike.

mplus.hero_note: Diabolist carries the Best tags for Mythic+ and Delves with a more passive AoE less reliant on Demonic Core procs; Soul Harvester is on similar footing. The AoE game adds Implosion and Summon Doomguard on top of the single-target priority.
tips: Cast Implosion to consume Wild Imps once they have dealt their damage
Weave Demonbolt onto additional targets to spread Doom: each application is its own damage source
Bank at least 2 Demonic Core charges before each Summon Demonic Tyrant to fund extra Wild Imps
Keep Call Dreadstalkers on cooldown before entering the Tyrant window so Reign of Tyranny extends it
Never let Soul Shards sit at 5; spender priority is Call Dreadstalkers then Hand of Gul'dan
